saints.name: St. Gildas the Wise
saints.title: Monk
saints.shortBlurb: A British monk and historian whose fierce sermon on the ruin of Britain is a chief witness to a lost age…
biography: Gildas was a British monk of the sixth century, educated in the monastic schools of Wales, whose fame rests on his book On the Ruin and Conquest of Britain. In it he denounced the sins of the princes and clergy of his people and mourned the collapse of Roman Christian Britain under the pagan Saxons.

For much of history his was almost the only voice from that darkened age, making him an indispensable, if severe, witness. He later crossed to Brittany and founded a monastery at Rhuys, where he died about 570.
saints.knownFor: His history On the Ruin of Britain.
